fields.recommendedUse: Water and wastewater disinfection, chemical manufacturing. Industrial use only; not for consumer use.
hazardClasses: Specific target organ toxicity, single exposure - Category 3 (respiratory)
Hazardous to the aquatic environment, acute - Category 1
hazardStatements: H270 May cause or intensify fire; oxidizer.
H280 Contains gas under pressure; may explode if heated.
H400 Very toxic to aquatic life.
precautionaryStatements: P220 Keep away from clothing and other combustible materials.
P244 Keep valves and fittings free from oil and grease.
P284 In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection.
P304+P340 IF INHALED: Remove person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing.
P310 Immediately call a POISON CENTER or doctor.
P370+P376 In case of fire: Stop leak if safe to do so.
P410+P403 Protect from sunlight. Store in a well-ventilated place.

firstAid.inhalation: Move to fresh air at once. If not breathing, give artificial respiration; if breathing is difficult, trained personnel should give oxygen. Keep at rest. Get immediate medical attention.
firstAid.skin: Contact with liquid may cause frostbite. Flush with lukewarm water for at least 15 minutes; do not rub. Remove contaminated clothing. Get medical attention.
firstAid.eyes: Immediately flush with plenty of water for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open. Remove contact lenses if easy to do. Get immediate medical attention.
firstAid.ingestion: Not an expected route of exposure for a gas.
firstAid.notes: Coughing, choking, chest tightness and burning eyes. Pulmonary edema may be delayed up to 48 hours: keep exposed persons under medical observation.

fields.controls: Closed system with local exhaust and continuous leak detection (alarm at 0.5 ppm). Eyes: gas-tight goggles and face shield. Skin: chlorine-resistant gloves and suit for leak response. Respiratory: full-face APR with chlorine cartridges below 10 ppm; positive-pressure SCBA above 10 ppm or at unknown concentrations.
